description:
Return the full text of one EvidujZdarma guide (Czech, Markdown) including FAQ and sources, by slug from eet_search_guides.

Args:
  - slug (string): a slug returned by eet_search_guides. Only guides that passed expert review are available.
  - response_format ('markdown'|'json').

Returns: slug, title, url, updated, reviewed, text (truncated at 25,000 characters).
name: eet_get_guide
title: Read an EET 2.0 guide
